body.x: Samsung(www.samsung.com) announced Galaxy Note3 at the 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
Samsung Galaxy Note 3, which is 8.3mm thick and weighs 168g, comes with a 5.7-inch full HD Super AMOLED display, 3,200 mAh battery, and 2.3GHz quad-core Snapdragon 800 processor.

'2014 international CES(Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
